{"subject":"Checking in from Harbor Street","body":"Hi,

I've been thinking about Replicate lately and wanted to check in. I'd love to hear what you're building and what's on your mind for the next few months.

If it's useful, I'm happy to set up a 20-minute call at whatever time works for you. No agenda beyond catching up and hearing how things are going.

Hope the team is doing well.

Maya"}
